note: Iosco County publishes no county-wide zoning service. Townships and cities zone their own land and publish zoning as PDF maps and ordinances (Oscoda Charter Township, Tawas City, Tawas Township, Reno, Wilber, Au Sable, Baldwin). The ArcGIS Zoning_Districts layer found (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) holds 1,129 features from other Michigan jurisdictions and none in Iosco County. The only digital zoning in Iosco is a consultant copy of Oscoda Township parcels with ZONING25 (services6.arcgis.com/vZ3jeQwJVemZEUsf, layer 11), which does not cover the sample point and is one township only.
